bullets.text: Copilot Enhances Text Editing - **Microsoft** Copilot now allows real-time text editing during Vision sessions for seamless collaboration.
Microsoft Store Milestone - Over 250 million users enjoyed a more personalized experience in the **Microsoft Store** in 2025.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and updates are rolling out in **Windows 11** Insider Preview Build 26220.7523.
AI Application Development Leader - **Microsoft** recognized as a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for AI platforms.
Unified Access Security - **Microsoft** introduces Access Fabric for improved identity and network access management.
Azure Updates for Partners - **Microsoft** outlines key Azure updates to enhance partner capabilities in AI integration.
